languages.description: The story's languages, edited in the dev mode.

chapter_map.description: Show players a Map tab: the dev mode's chapters with their quests where they were placed, arrows to the quests that follow, each coloured by the player's progress (as in FTB Quests). Quests in no chapter go to a last chapter.

difficulty.description: How every quest shows its difficulty. Without it: levels easy (green), normal (yellow), hard (red), deadly (dark red).

style.description: stars: 1 to 5, shown ★★★☆☆ as in Stardew Valley; levels: the level's name in its colour.

levels.description: Up to 5, in order of difficulty: the n-th is what n stars mean, so quests may use either.

name.description: A translation key or the text itself; default storybound.difficulty.<id>.
